categories.detail: All six intended questions, three available/accepted and three acquisition-blocked per arm; measured CPU/wall includes verification and packaging
Not a population estimate; common per-intended-job gate, no retry into availability

source.limitation: Employee wage anchor; excludes benefits and is not a contractor quote or willingness-to-pay observation.

categories.detail: Gross wage proxy; actual fully loaded employer or contractor cost unknown
